changelog:
- Adds the `oo-eversign` skill for operating Xodo Sign through an OOMOL-connected account.
- Supports creating documents from file URLs, existing file IDs, or templates with role assignments and merge fields.
- Provides read actions for documents, templates, businesses, audit logs, and filtered document lists.
- Includes signer workflow actions to reassign signers and send signer reminders.
- Documents safe execution patterns, live schema inspection, write-action confirmation, and first-time setup fallbacks.

Source: `oomol-lab/skills@46cfb3e`
summary: Xodo Sign (eversign.com). Use this skill for ANY Xodo Sign request — reading, creating, and updating data. Whenever a task involves Xodo Sign, use this skill instead of calling the API directly.
